description: NaCN₄H₃O crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmma space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one NaCN₄H₃O sheet oriented in the (np.int64(1), np.int64(0), np.int64(0)) direction. Na is bonded to four equivalent N and two equivalent O atoms to form face-sharing NaN₄O₂ octahedra. All Na-N bond lengths are 2.59 Å. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.40 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent N and one H atom. Both C-N bond lengths are 1.34 Å. The C-H bond length is 1.09 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a water-like geometry to two N atoms. There is one shorter (1.32 Å) and one longer (1.35 Å) N-N bond length. In the second N site, N is bonded to two equivalent Na, one C, and one N atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NNa₂CN tetrahedra. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms.
